entities.name: San Domenico, Arezzo
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Basilica of San Domenico is a Gothic-style church in Arezzo, Tuscany, Italy, dedicated to St Dominic. It is especially renowned for housing a painted crucifix (1265) by Cimabue.
